notes.title: BlueGlow Year 2 Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34703290/444a4dee3d14c54ede023b11cd5d16619f99a880.png[/img]
BlueGlow has officially wrapped up Year 1. The games first year helped shape it into what it is now, many free updates and content drops came that changed the game. Year 1 started off with a handful of new maps in the first few months and as the months progressed, new game modes were added. [i]Ground War[/i] and the [i]Operations[/i] mode came with some of the largest content drops since launch. After those, many free updates including the [i]Graphics Update[/i] dropped. Year 2 has now begun and is dropping with the free [i]Year 2 Pass[/i]. All players will have immediate access to both the [i]Year 1 Pass[/i] alongside the new [i]Year 2 Pass[/i], containing all post launch content. Year 2 launches with a new free [i]Operation[/i], follow the [i]Death Road[/i] leading into the military base and prepare for the next Operation, as well as many game changes and new maps to play on. [i]Year 2[/i] will bring more content than ever as we continue developing this game.

Patch Notes
[list]
[*]Free [i]Year 1 & 2 Pass[/i] including new content
[*]Added the new [i]Operation Death Road[/i] DLC
[*]Added the new Red Vs Blue map, [i]Cargo[/i]
[*]Multiple Game Overhauls
[*]Sound & Music Overhaul
[*]Main Menu UI Rework
[*]Reworked Gamemode Systems
[*]Graphical Updates
[*]Updated to Unreal Engine v4.24
[*]Begun work on Multiplayer Support
[*]Updated Steam Page
[*]Updated What’s New Page
[*]Updated Patch Notes Page on the Extras menu.
[*]Optimization in the Survival gamemode.
[*]Several bug fixes in the Survival gamemode.
[*]Improved performance in Survival.
[*]Arcade mode bug fixes.
[*]Red vs Blue bug fixes.
[*]General Bug Fixes.
[/list]

[h1]Operation Death Road[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34703290/a645b2b175fc7b4212df0057689d64bef99ec740.png[/img]
You must infiltrate the Red Military base and collect the Black Ops data box. The only way to reach the compound however is through the Death road. It will take you throughout the red capital city. It is is overrun with red soldiers, so be careful. Go in silent or loud, It is up to you. Good luck.

[h1]Cargo[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34703290/73aa4d7a9c1378a8b21ead9c53fd0bd6399a0740.png[/img]
Play in the new [i]Red Vs Blue[/i] map included with the free Year 2 Pass. Engage in close quarters combat in one of the smallest maps for lots of quick, chaotic action.

[h3]The Year 2 Update is out now for free! Thank you for playing.[/h3]

notes.title: BlueGlow v1.4 Operation Blue Rain DLC Update Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1][b]BlueGlow v1.4 and Operation Blue Rain DLC FREE now![/b][/h1]

The v1.4 update is the biggest content update since the release of the game. With the last 2 updates, 1.3 and 1.3.1, we have focused on overhauling game systems and the coding. This will not be apparent in game, but it will let us expand the game with lots of new content. The new Operations mode is the focus for the update and free DLC. We have also changed the price of the base game to $2.99 USD. This is to help us keep the game running and alive but we will continue supporting it with completely free updates.

You can download the free Operation Blue Rain DLC HERE, https://store.steampowered.com/app/1118540
[h1][b]Operation Blue Rain[/b][/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34703290/e8ae6bd877f305c45fc0a066083e2904810fe6bf.png[/img]
This Free DLC adds Operation Blue Rain into the Operations mode for BlueGlow. The new Operations mode adds longer objective and story based missions to BlueGlow. More Operations will come soon with Operation Blue Rain kicking off the new stream of content.

Operation Blue Rain has you sneak into a military base to steal the enemy's data. Quietly enter and move through the base. Kill all of the enemy, or sneak past them, it's all up to the player. Steal the data and try to escape. This is the first of the Operations with more coming soon.

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[list]
[*] [i]Operations[/i] mode added.
[*] Free Operation Blue Rain DLC added adding the first of many Operations.
[*] Main Menu UI overhaul.
[*] Added new [i]What' New[/i] section.
[*] Updated Patch Notes page on the Extras menu.
[*] Optimization in the Survival gamemode.
[*] Several bug fixes in the Survival gamemode.
[*] Improved performance in Survival.
[*] Arcade mode bug fixes.
[*] Red vs Blue bug fixes.
[*] Coding for game modes has been overhauled.
[*] Better backbone for future content.
[*] Bug Fixes.
[/list]

Thank you for supporting the game. The future of BlueGlow is only going to get brighter with more free DLC's and content.

notes.title: BlueGlow v1.3 Update & Patch Notes
notes.content:
[i][b][h1]BlueGlow v1.3 Update is out NOW.[/h1][/b][/i]
The v1.3 Update brings new content alongside many bug fixes! As the roadmap released 2 months ago comes to a close, development will continue on adding new content to be announced in the next few weeks. v1.3 is one of the biggest updates yet for BlueGlow with much more to come.
v1.3 Brings a new gamemode, [i]Ground War[/i]. More on Ground War at the end of this post.

[h1][b]Patch Notes[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Added New gamemode, [i]Ground War[/i].
[*] Updated Patch Notes page on the [i]Extras menu[/i].
[*] Bug Fixes
[*] Fixed wall clipping bug on [i]Red Vs Blue[/i] maps.
[*] Optimization in the [i]Survival[/i] gamemode.
[*] Several bug fixes in the [i]Survival[/i] gamemode.
[*] Revamped [i]Veteran[/i] difficulty for [i]Survival[/i] and [i]Ground War[/i].
[*] Replaced [i]Survival Veteran[/i] with a harder [i]Veteran[/i] difficulty.
[*] Improved performance in Survival.
[*] And more fixes.
[/list]

[h1][b]Ground War[/b][/h1]
The new Map, Ground War will be a separate mode like Survival. Ground War is 4x the size of a normal Red vs Blue map and it will focus on larger scale combat. Ground War is a more hardcore map so it will come with the redesigned Veteran mode, only available in Survival and Ground War, taking place of the Survival Veteran difficulty. The map will have a very different flow from Red vs Blue and Survival while still sharing similarities between them. Ground War brings a new design for item pickups by having them in drops with everything you need in a predestined location. This will make the items more abundant and make you have to be more careful with your health, armor, and ammo. Ground War will be a short, but large scale map for those who enjoy the space of Survival but wants shorter and easier to get into matches.
Here are some screenshots of the new map.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34703290/52e69ac5392087a03092c646acb70dd6046ebb0b.png[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34703290/6021843bfde56e477ba9e78dee9721a00dade664.png[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34703290/17547260b1f3887bcf41641a53626166040af9e3.png[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34703290/32e1994c91301b8c5aa05d9772b82ec95ffdae7f.png[/img]

notes.title: v1.3 Update Delay and Content Announcement
notes.content:
[h1][i][b]v1.3 for BlueGlow had been delayed.[/b][/i][/h1]
v1.3 was originally set to release by the end of April as an update to the [i]Arcade[/i] mode. It was then pushed to early May due to the development of the map lasting longer than expected. Early May came and the map was functional but still needed some touching up. Since then there has been many new implementations to the map and it has been coming out very well. The update is planned to release before or during the beginning of June. Thank you for the wait, now for the announcement of the map.

[h1]Ground War Announcement[/h1]
The new Map, [i]Ground War[/i] will not be a part of the Arcade mode and will be a separate mode like [i]Survival[/i]. [i]Ground War[/i] is 4x the size of a normal [i]Red vs Blue[/i] map, it will focus on larger scale combat with no time limit, similarly like [i]Survival[/i]. [i]Ground War[/i] is a more hardcore map so it will come with the redesigned [i]Veteran[/i] mode, only available in [i]Survival[/i] and [i]Ground War[/i], taking place of the [i]Survival Veteran[/i] difficulty. The map will have a very different flow from [i]Red vs Blue[/i] and [i]Survival[/i] while still sharing similarities between them. [b][i]Ground War is coming soon in the v1.3 Content Drop. Stay tuned.[/i][/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34703290/6021843bfde56e477ba9e78dee9721a00dade664.png[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34703290/17547260b1f3887bcf41641a53626166040af9e3.png[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34703290/32e1994c91301b8c5aa05d9772b82ec95ffdae7f.png[/img]

notes.title: BlueGlow Update 1.1
notes.content:
[h1][i][b]All owners of BlueGlow will receive the new free update version 1.1.0[/b][/i][/h1]
This free new update improves on performance in the Survival gamemode and adds new features.

[i][b]Patch Notes[/b][/i]
[list]
[*] Improved performance for the [i]Survival[/i] gamemode.
[*] Added a new [i]Extras[/i] menu with a new [i]Character Viewer.[/i]
[*] Fixed multiple bugs for the [i]Survival[/i] gamemode.
[*] Added more changes in the [i]Survival[/i] gamemode*.
[/list]
[i]*See the Survival change list for details[/i]

[b][i]Survival Patch Changes[/i][/b]
[list]
[*] Improved performance.
[*] Added more enemies in the Southwest region of the map along with a higher loot ratio for more risk and reward gameplay.
[*] Added big structures in open areas, changing the flow of transitioning.
[*] Changes in structure of some buildings.
[*] Multiple bug fixes.
[/list]

[i]Thank you for supporting BlueGlow and more updates will come in the future.[/i]
